questions: What exact freshness/lag SLO and bounded reread policy should M9 encode for each dimension when source evidence is present but older than the projection snapshot?
Which concrete Run Authority and Custody source APIs are the canonical reread surfaces for positive control paths in this repo, and are any still missing a shared adapter?
Which historical compatibility projections must remain readable at M9 closeout, and what explicit zero-reader evidence is acceptable for expiry?

success_criteria.criterion: Generated reader inventory and `research/wbc-boundary-adoption-matrix.md` show zero unapproved raw authority readers and every remaining compatibility projection is explicitly marked non-authoritative with an expiry gate.
Deleting and rebuilding every in-scope projection yields byte-stable ordered views and matching digests from authoritative records plus immutable evidence only.
Forged or stale Run Authority, WBC, custody, and status projections cannot produce a positive action until current source grant/fence and lease/epoch records are reread and joined.
Resident, cloud, CLI, watchdog, and auditor views agree for identical fixture inputs; disagreements emit structured drift with exact evidence IDs instead of optimistic status collapse.
Observer-purity tests prove reads from status, resident, watchdog, and introspection surfaces do not append progress, activity, lifecycle, delivery, or repair evidence.

Discord `/whats-cooking` keeps `attention` as an overlay only: live execution or active repair remains listed, labels prefer `progress.display_state`, and attention reasons do not replace execution truth.

Work-ledger outputs distinguish productive, replayed, validation-only, retry/rework, and unavailable categories without classifying legitimate implementation or required review as orchestration waste.
Deterministic reason fixtures each fire exactly once with exact evidence IDs for the required M9 block/drift/coverage classes.

Retention/privacy/migration tests cover stored payloads, legal hold, cross-tenant denial, missing keys, expiry/tombstones, interrupted migration, and explicitly unbackfillable legacy history; metadata-only validation does not pass.
All generated M9 evidence artifacts are present, tracked as expected, and regenerated diff-clean at finalize.
The final execution graph remains below the 48-minute hard threshold with a documented 42-minute critical path and 46-minute dispatch graph.
Shared projection helpers remain small enough that consumer migrations mostly wire existing data through one contract instead of duplicating parallel status logic in each consumer.
Compatibility bridges are isolated behind explicit adapter seams and reader-count/expiry evidence so M10 can delete them without another status-system redesign.
Stakeholder sign-off on the chosen freshness/lag SLO values is recorded before promotion from shadow comparison to any control-path use.

assumptions: Existing exact-version query surfaces from M6A/M8A are available or can be wrapped without reopening the milestone architecture.
Positive control actions remain disabled during shadow comparison and canary work, so M9 can harden readers before authorizing any promotion.
`research/wbc-boundary-adoption-matrix.md` and `evidence/m9-f01-f17-consumer-cutover.json` either already exist or may be created as milestone artifacts.
The adjacent review/rework presentation slice at commit `07f428d361f63c465b0dafaca9783585efeaa4b9` remains the behavior baseline for display-state parity and should not be redesigned.
Any scope pressure should remove compatibility bridges last and only with explicit zero-reader evidence; it should not weaken fail-closed authority or observer purity.
